summary.text: Max Wise is a Republican state senator who has represented District 16 since January 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Max Wise was born in Campbellsville, Kentucky, and graduated from Campbellsville High School in 1993.

He received a bachelor's degree from Campbellsville University, attended the Patterson School of Diplomacy at the University of Kentucky in 1999, and received an advanced certificate from Texas A&M University.
His career experience includes working as a professor with Campbellsville University and the University of Kentucky.
Senate Republicans elected Wise majority leader of the Kentucky State Senate in November 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Committee on Committees, Economic Development, Tourism and Labor, Education, Families and Children, and Rules committees.
